### 3) `aub_next_fix.py ...`
Purpose: produce a concrete “next fix” plan in `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` based on failure patterns.
- This is what you use when autopilots don’t produce a PASS candidate: it should point to the most leveraged fix.

- Are runs completing (no timeouts/crashes)?
- Are metrics comparable (same dataset/seed/splits)?
- Is promotion gated on **mean**, **min**, or both (and which one is blocking)?
- Are “tuning” vs “lockbox” deltas suggesting overfitting (tuning improves but lockbox doesn’t)?

If you share the contents (or key sections) of `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` after running the three commands, I can propose the most likely fix and how to encode it into the registry/spec.
